description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Townhome! * Private Walk to Beach Access* Private Pool - Heated for add'l $50/nt* 6 Fun Pug Bikes ( addition fee $168) * FREE Seasonal Beach Service - 4 Chairs and 2 Umbrellas (March 1-Oct 31)* Perfect location that's walking distance to restaurants and a bike-ride away from Seaside* Gated Path to the Beach is shared only with neighboring property. * Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* 2 miles to Seaside! Enjoy activities like free outdoor movies* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service **This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.** **There is a limit of 4 parking spots (medium sized vehicles) for this unit**Escape to Rays on 30A, a stunning beachfront luxury duplex that has been beautifully renovated. This 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home offers unparalleled oceanfront living, complete with private beach access, a sparkling private pool, and 3 balconies to enjoy breathtaking views of the water. On the first floor, you’ll find a guest bedroom with two full-over-full bunk beds and a shared bathroom. Just down the hall, a second guest bedroom features a king bed. Upstairs on the second floor, the open-concept living area boasts a newly-renovated kitchen, while a queen guest bedroom offers a private balcony with pool views and an ensuite bathroom. The third floor is home to the luxurious master suite, complete with a king bed, desk, and lounge chairs, plus a balcony with a chair swing perfect for watching the sunset over the ocean. A newly-renovated private bathroom with a walk-in shower adds to the suite’s appeal. Down the hall, another guest bedroom overlooking the pool offers a king bed and an ensuite bathroom. Make Rays on 30A your go-to family getaway and create unforgettable memories year after year!Located in Seagrove Beach, Beach Love is two townhomes, East and West, located directly on the beach. A variety of restaurants and retail shops are within walking distance on Scenic Hwy 30A. This fantastic location offers quick access to Seaside and Rosemary Beach! Also enjoy exploring the many art galleries, and more in nearby Watercolor and Grayton Beach.The Bed Setup: 1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: 2 Full over Full BunkbedsGuest Bedroom 2: King Bed2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom 3: Queen Bed3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom 4: King Bed Area Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous.30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
